ev.q: Rising Storm 2 Vietnam is a real gem if you're into realistic shooters
the whole Vietnam War setting feels incredibly immersive
realistic weapon handling that the series is known for
Enjoyable multiplayer Vietnam war game you can play as different factions
4 flyable helicopters - Huey, Cobra, Loach and Bushranger
Not easy but fun to pick up and dive into the action
the gun play does legitimately feel quite nice
